gaps: Verify the new event has a different RFX/stage code from the old event.
Verify the recreated event has the same product identity and delivery location as the old event.
Verify the recreated event has exactly the same participants as the old event.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary as required for prepared-state cases.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the stage Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Verify the recreate dialog includes Product Sheet.
Verify the recreate dialog includes Auction Configurations.
Verify the recreate dialog includes Delivery Date.
Verify the scheduling choice is present.
Check that the requested 60-minute end-time duration is offered.
Set the recreated event's end-time duration to 60 minutes.
Confirm the duration control shows 60 Mins.
Create the recreated order while retaining the default 30-minute evaluation and no schedule selection.
Confirm the new event page opened.
Verify the recreated event is live immediately.
Verify the live event page exposes its bidding end time.
Verify the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ's quantity.
Confirm recreation completed without an application error.
